title: Make manual room creation and admin membership writes atomic

source.ref: Current createRoom separate inserts and demoteRoomMember stale count/update; no existing registered atomic room RPC

detail: Independent source/migration census confirms room+creator membership are separate writes and demotion checks an admin count before a later update. Local proposal docs/database/room-atomic-proposal.sql defines three service-only SECURITY INVOKER RPCs for create, role changes and manual leave/kick. Parent row locks precede current caller/admin-count checks. No global trigger, account/profile cascade or system provisioning change. Fifteen disposable embedded PostgreSQL checks pass, including actual old failure schedules, rollback, ACLs, role refusals, manual last-admin handling and unchanged cascades; eight guarded adapter tests pass. No independent two-session concurrency or live PostgREST acceptance is claimed. ROOM_ATOMIC_WRITES stays blank/off, SQL is outside the migration directory and the existing860-file inventory is unchanged. App adapter wiring remains conditional and cannot activate before separately approved SQL registration and rollout; enabled RPC errors must fail closed with no legacy-write fallback. Local action branches are now wired for create, promote/demote, manual self-leave and kick using only trusted caller identity; existing authentication/admin/self boundaries remain. Enabled RPC errors or malformed acknowledgements fail closed without legacy fallback or success revalidation. Flag-off legacy behavior is covered separately. ROOM_ATOMIC_WRITES remains blank/off; this code wiring does not register/apply SQL or authorize rollout.

verify.evidence: Close only after independent SQL review, CLI-generated migration registration, real isolated two-session lock/race proof, exact registered database/app readiness and authorized rollout/acceptance. Local proposal, adapter tests and reproducible no-network PGlite harness are complete but do not establish production deployment or a global last-admin invariant. Account/profile and direct maintenance deletions remain unchanged. See docs/ROOM-ATOMIC-WRITES.md.
